definitions.gloss: in order; in turn; one by one
definitions.explanation: Following a proper sequence; each taking their turn without skipping.

examples.japanese: {順々|じゅんじゅん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{並|なら}んで→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
{順々|じゅんじゅん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{呼|よ}びます→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧。
examples.english: I will call names in order.

examples.japanese: ⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{順々|じゅんじゅん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{解|と}いて→解く：02301_toku⟧⟦いく→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: To solve problems one by one in order.

notes:
USAGE: Emphasizes following proper order or sequence. Similar to ⟦{順番|じゅんばん}→順番：03283_junban⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ but with more emphasis on the one-by-one aspect.

PATTERN: {順々|じゅんじゅん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ + verb

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{順番|じゅんばん}→順番：03283_junban⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (in order, by turns)
- ⟦{次々|つぎつぎ}→次々：03522_tsugitsugi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (one after another - less emphasis on order)
- ⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧⟦ずつ→〜ずつ：03092_zutsu⟧ (one by one)

NOTE: The repetition (ABAB pattern) emphasizes the systematic nature of the sequence.
